prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1397; do not mention it.)
text:
I represent the individual injured in the sideswipe collision described below, which occurred while the insured vehicle was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries that are still under medical evaluation, and we expect the full extent of the damages to be documented in the coming weeks.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person, and do not request any statement from them without our prior written consent.

Please provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy that covers the insured driver and vehicle, along with confirmation of any additional coverage that may apply.

We also ask that you preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the insured's vehicle and any repair records, photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, claim file materials, and any communications with the insured or other parties. Please ensure that no evidence is altered, repaired, or destroyed while the claim is pending.
